parameters.description_en:
The project ID.
1. You can log on to the [IoT application development console](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). After selecting the corresponding instance in the upper-left corner of the page, click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
2. In the standard project list, locate the target project, click the project card, and then check the address bar of your browser.

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must pass this ID value. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.</props>

<props="china">
> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
